# Dubu Business

## About
Dubu Business is a payment infrastructure platform for fintech builders, remittance platforms, and businesses that need to move money across borders at scale. It provides a single API to accept USD, NGN, and stablecoins (USDT/USDC), convert currencies with controlled rates, and settle funds in under 5 minutes. Built for developers and financial operators who need programmable, cross-border payment rails — not a hosted checkout product.

## The Payment Pipeline

### 01 · Accept — Customer pays in their currency
USD via ACH/Wire, NGN via NUBAN virtual accounts, or USDT/USDC on-chain. One payment session, every rail open.

### 02 · Verify — Webhooks confirm instantly
Signed payloads hit your endpoint the moment money lands. No polling, no manual chasing, no stalled transfers.

### 03 · Convert — The FX engine does the math
Controlled rates between USD, NGN, and stablecoins — transparent pricing, no hidden spread.

### 04 · Settle — Funds land in under 5 minutes
NGN bank accounts, external USD destinations, or crypto wallets — routed by rules you define.

## Features

- Cross-border payments: Accept USD, NGN, and stablecoins in one unified flow — built for international customers and Nigerian collections
- API + webhooks: Create payment sessions, verify via signed webhooks, automate fulfillment end-to-end
- USD infrastructure: Issue USD virtual accounts, receive via ACH/Wire, pay out to external USD accounts
- NGN collections: NUBAN virtual accounts for local payments, unified with global reporting
- Crypto payments: USDT/USDC deposit addresses, withdrawals, and on-chain transfers — auto-reconciled
- Checkout links: No-code payment links and invoices — share via email or WhatsApp, track everything
- Fast payouts: Withdraw to NGN banks, send crypto to wallets, or settle in USD — most payouts in under 5 minutes

## Pricing

### NGN (Local payments)
- Rate: 0.85% flat
- No cap
- Includes: NGN bank transfers, NUBAN virtual accounts, checkout links, instant settlement, webhooks, dashboard analytics

### USD (International payments via ACH & SWIFT)
- Under $300: flat $1 fee
- $300 to $1,000: flat $2.50 fee
- Above $1,000: 0.4% (minimum $2.50)
- Includes: USD send & receive via ACH & SWIFT, USD virtual accounts, cross-border payouts, webhooks, dashboard analytics

### Revenue Split (High-volume merchants)
Custom revenue-sharing for merchants processing ₦100M+ monthly — reduced effective rate as volume grows, dedicated account manager, priority settlement.

## Use Cases
- Global remittances: Fast, low-cost transfers across borders with USD, NGN, and stablecoin rails
- Stablecoin on/off ramps: Collect USDT/USDC, settle to fiat, route liquidity with programmable policies
- Borderless banking: Multi-currency accounts so users can hold, pay, and settle globally
- International SaaS billing: Accept global payments, confirm via webhooks, provision access instantly
- Marketplace payments: Collect from buyers worldwide, pay sellers locally with rule-based settlement
- Cross-border payouts: Withdraw to NGN accounts, send USD externally, or route crypto to wallets
- Digital goods & vouchers: Create sessions, verify instantly, fulfill orders automatically via API
- FX-enabled checkout: Convert between USD, NGN, and crypto with controlled rates

## Key Stats
- Settlement time: under 5 minutes for most payouts
- Supported rails: ACH, SWIFT/Wire, NUBAN virtual accounts, USDT/USDC on-chain
- Countries: 50+
- NGN settlement rate: 99.7%
- USD payments from: $1

## API Overview
- Base URL: https://api.dubupay.com/v1
- Auth: Bearer token (sk_live_… for production, sk_test_… for sandbox)
- Webhooks: HMAC-SHA512 signed payloads
- Idempotency: supported — safe retries
- Key endpoints: POST /sessions, POST /payouts, GET /transactions

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Dubu Business?
A: Dubu Business is a payment infrastructure API for businesses that need to accept cross-border payments, convert currencies, and settle funds fast — across USD, NGN, and stablecoins.

Q: What currencies and rails does Dubu Business support?
A: USD via ACH and SWIFT/Wire, NGN via NUBAN virtual accounts, and USDT/USDC on-chain (Base and Solana). All three rails are available from a single API session.

Q: How fast is settlement?
A: Most payouts settle in under 5 minutes — to NGN bank accounts, external USD destinations, or crypto wallets.

Q: What are the fees?
A: NGN transactions: 0.85% flat. USD transactions: $1 flat under $300, $2.50 from $300–$1,000, and 0.4% above $1,000 (minimum $2.50). No setup fees, no subscriptions.

Q: How do webhooks work?
A: Every payment event triggers a signed HMAC-SHA512 payload to your endpoint. No polling needed — your server receives instant confirmation the moment funds land.

Q: Is there a sandbox for testing?
A: Yes. Use test keys (sk_test_…) to simulate payment sessions, webhooks, and payouts without real funds.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Sign up at merchant.dubupay.com, grab your API keys, and follow the docs at docs.dubupay.com. Book a demo at https://forms.gle/wAvp4gazqpJrccm77 for a guided walkthrough.
